title: Safari GitHub Handoff Re-Publication and Native Contract Compatibility — Final Report
summary: Lane S4 republishes the Safari Web Extension boundary as a consumable actual slice and proves that the Q0 extension protocol is compatible with the N1 native contract boundary. The Q0 Safari extension already existed on remote main at commit 76f83dd7. This lane adds missing icon assets, creates a structured N1-Q0 contract compatibility audit artifact, and adds 20 new contract compatibility tests that validate JS-produced JSON messages against Python Pydantic models, schema conformance, popup action-to-envelope contracts, and N1 field-level compatibility. The audit proves that no protocol redesign is required — N1 can consume Q0 messages by extracting recognized string keys from the opaque payload dictionary. Five integration deeds are identified, all additive extensions to N1.
